units.source_text: 他又回头看了一眼女人。

en.t: He turned back and glanced at the woman again.

units.source_text: 这时他绝没有再凑近一点看的心思。

en.t: At that moment, he had absolutely no desire to move any closer and look.

units.source_text: 让沙子裹住的女人，是视觉的，很难说是触觉的。

en.t: The woman wrapped in sand was something visual; it was hard to call her something tactile.
